notes.title: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer - coming this Summer!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35308881/2de20143f4a379f8ef662a9a71c9f03e778bf0f2.jpg[/img]

A [b]card game/visual novel [/b]hybrid where you get on a life of fantasy adventure, make decisions, and face the consequences (some of them being beautiful girls). Forge your destiny, and remember to keep all your stats nice and balanced!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936310/Sugoi_Adventure_DragonSlayer/

[b]Get on a quest of your lifetime! [/b]
This kingdom needs a hero, and that's exactly who you happen to be. Make your way to glory!

[b]Maintain your stats! [/b]
Money, health, stress, and fame - will you be able to balance your way through the heroic journey?

[b]Gather your party![/b]
Get yourself some skillful allies! But beware of the temptations along the way...

[b]Get rid of that nasty Dragon! [/b]
Make your daddy proud.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A fun tale of might, magic, and well-built women!
[*] Over 300 adventure cards to go through
[*] Six girls available for romance 💕
[*] A free DLC at launch! (❤️ω❤️*)
[*] Multiple endings
[*] Various achievements
[*] Trading cards - as soon as Steam allows us to add them!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936310/Sugoi_Adventure_DragonSlayer/

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
- New artbook pages added
- Korean translation updated

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Additions:
- Added Replay submenu under the Gallery menu. You can now replay your favourite scenes from the DLC.
- Added stages to several CGs

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where some larger CG images didn't produce correct thumbnails
- Fixed an issue where CG 1 on Page 2 wouldn't unlock

- Fixed an issue where after you get a bad end and return to previous choice, the state of the scene wouldn't be properly restored.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where in the binoculars scene interactive part the binoculars showed black background
- Fixed a rare issue where loading form the choice after the binoculars scene in DLC version lead to an error screen
- Fixed an issue where DLC gallery would throw an error screen if normal gallery screen was on page >1

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content: - Fixes an issue where Rin Appreciator achievement wasn't accessible due to relationship score miscalculation.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
- Adds a gallery subsection for DLC images
- Fixes an issue where History screen wouldn't be called with mouse scroll
- Fixes a few minor tag typos in Brazilian and German translations

notes.title: Patch notes - 1.01 and 1.02
notes.content:
1.01 - fixed an issue where sessions started without DLC couldn't proceed beyond the Binoculars scene
1.02 - fixed an issue where Chasing Tails achievement couldn't be unlocked despite having seen all endings

Found a bug? Post it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1555110/discussions/0/4737210531933440880/]here[/url]!

notes.title: A new Ecchi Comedy title announced: Chasing Tails
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35308881/650046a40b558ae710f7ca44826f8524e21fdc80.jpg[/img]

A yuri comedy/horror visual novel, featuring a haunted house, fox-girls, and girl x girl love ❤︎

Trying to get away from trouble, June moves to a small town... to find even more trouble! Oh my, why do these embarrassing situations just keep on happening?!

It appears June's new house is haunted! And if that wasn't bad enough, seems like she's being pursued by a female stalker! The strange girl is sure looking good, but what about her intentions? And what's up with those strange dreams June started seeing since she moved in? And, most importantly, are there fox-girls involved?!

Uncover the town's secrets and make girls' hearts connect in this [b]comedy/horror yuri visual novel[/b] <3

[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2]
[list][*]A heartwarming story with a bunch of funny moments and a pinch of horror
[*]Two heroines available for romance
[*]Official Steam 18+ DLC on release
[*]Multiple endings
[*]Various achievements
[*]Trading cards - as soon as Steam allows us to add them![/list]

[b]Add to your Wishlist now not to miss the launch - and be the first one to play![/b]
